en: Added `store.connect_timeout_seconds` to the Claude apps gateway config to lengthen the Postgres connect timeout (default 5 seconds), and improved the boot error when the database is unreachable to point to `store.postgres_url` and the configured timeout
zh: 在 Claude 应用网关配置中新增 `store.connect_timeout_seconds`，用于延长 Postgres 连接超时（默认 5 秒），并改进数据库不可达时的启动错误，指向 `store.postgres_url` 和已配置的超时
